def _get_single_child(name: str, statistics: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]
    ) ->Optional[str]:
    prefix = name + ("." if name else "")
    children = []
    for mod_name in statistics:
        # Check if this module is a direct child of the given name
        if mod_name.startswith(prefix) and mod_name.count(".") == prefix.count(".") + 1:
            children.append(mod_name)
    
    # Return the single child if exactly one exists, otherwise None
    return children[0] if len(children) == 1 else None
